scope: First normal Slash AWS baseline and preserved evidence; not an Alarm, incident-processing or recovery-completion report.

evidence.role: Actual Cognito and AWS HTTP checks; original first metric snapshot
One preflight plus 90 normal requests; status and time only
Independent interpretation of the initial runtime snapshot and source code
Application/schema startup checks, including retained PostgreSQL version warning
Read-only inventory after user-requested cleanup interruption
Read-only historical metric follow-up; final request publication tail visible
AWS ECS console: two active services and two running tasks
Actual HTTP verification result report rendered from result.json; not the AWS console
Original live Grafana capture with request rate, latency, error ratio and DB graphs
AWS CloudWatch console: actual metric series and request/error count plot

interpretation: The original snapshot was captured shortly after the last normal request. A later read-only query includes the 01:15 KST publication bucket with 23 additional requests, bringing the observed sum from 77 to 100.
The original 77 is not a lost-request count; it is an earlier, incomplete publication snapshot.

The observer records 91 calls. The complete verifier adds 10 HTTP probes, including two gateway-blocked management paths. Other application checks may also be counted, so the CloudWatch total is not expected to equal the observer-only total.
Exact request-by-request attribution was not traced; do not claim complete 100-request reconciliation.
The exporter explicitly excludes URI labels beginning /actuator. Health checks and Prometheus scrapes are not the explanation for the difference.
cloudwatch_followup.original_narrative_correction: The generic interpretation string in the byte-preserved original result.json mentions health paths. That statement is superseded by runtime-review.json and this index: exported /actuator timers are excluded.
cloudwatch_followup.mean_formula: Same-60-second duration total Sum divided by same-window count Sum; null for a zero denominator. These are means, not p95.
cloudwatch_followup.db_note: DB counts include instrumented scheduled queries. Active-connections zero is a sampled instant, not proof that the database was unused.

cleanup_observation.cause: Destroy was interrupted at the user request; this is a historical observation, not a new cleanup action.

screenshots.preservation: Selected captures are copied byte-for-byte; no pixels edited.
screenshots.grafana_excluded: The later 04-grafana-baseline.jpg shows no data after teardown and is not used as runtime evidence.
screenshots.visible_operational_identifiers: AWS console captures retain the already-authorized account number and IAM display name. They do not show access keys, passwords, login tokens, private tester IP or end-user response data.
screenshots.cloudwatch_capture_limit: The screenshot displays only selected request/error graph series; the JSON data provides all six metrics.

remaining_limits: Other-source-IP rejection was not tested from a separate source.
